profile.Name: Ace
profile.Personality: A boastful old drunk who calls himself the best shot in the Border Zone. His tall tales fall apart under questioning, but he bristles at anyone who mocks him, and he hints that he was once quicker to shoot.
profile.Backstory: He drinks grog in Squin and wears an eyepatch. He claims to have hunted banshees in sunken caves and leviathans as far as the coast, and to have shot a greenfruit off a noble's head, or at least near it. He gives no straight answer about his lost eye.
profile.SpeechQuirks: A slurred drawl: "Eh" for I, "thurr" for there, and stray s's on his words, as in "Ace the Dead-eye is the names." Bets he can make impossible shots and promises enemies a headshot from his bow.
